entries.jp: この技が戦況を優位にするぜ！
entries.en:
This move'll turn the
battle our way!

entries.jp: 技発動！戦況を有利にするぜ！
entries.en:
Move activated! I'll
turn the battle our way!

entries.jp: 今だっ！敵全体に連携攻撃！！
entries.en:
Now! A combo attack
on all the foes!!

entries.jp: 連携攻撃で、敵全体に攻撃だ！
entries.en:
A combo attack on
all the foes!

entries.jp: 武器に込めた怒り、思い知れ！
entries.en:
Feel the wrath I've
poured into my weapon!

entries.jp: 武器召喚！この攻撃を受けろ！
entries.en:
Weapon summon!
Take this attack!

entries.jp: オレと交代で控えの式神登場だ
entries.en:
I swap out and a
reserve shikigami comes in!

entries.jp: 空間変化で狙うぜ！攻撃力上昇
entries.en:
Shift the field!
We're goin' for an Attack boost!

entries.jp: 苦しいが、お前の為に頑張るぞ
entries.en:
It's tough, but I'll
hang in there for you.

entries.jp: 苦しいが、乗り切れば勝てる！
entries.en:
It's tough, but if we
pull through, we win!

entries.jp: 体力の限界だ。対応を頼むぞ
entries.en:
I'm at my limit.
Do somethin', will ya?

entries.jp: 苦しいが後一発入れさせてくれ
entries.en:
It's tough, but let me
land one more hit.

entries.jp: 体力が減ったな。慎重に動くぞ
entries.en:
My HP's down.
I'll move carefully.

entries.jp: 体力が減ってきた。どうする？
entries.en:
My HP's droppin'.
What do we do?

entries.jp: 体力を気にして、指示してくれ
entries.en:
Keep my HP in mind
when ya give orders.

entries.jp: 体力やべぇが、どうにかならぁ
entries.en:
My HP's in bad shape,
but I'll manage somehow.

entries.jp: 体力は充分だ！オレが攻めるぜ
entries.en:
Plenty of HP!
I'm goin' on the attack!

entries.jp: まだ体力はある。今は攻める！
entries.en:
I've still got HP.
Time to attack!

entries.jp: 体力は問題ない。ＳＰを溜めろ
entries.en:
HP's no problem.
Build up your SP.

entries.jp: 体力は気にすんな。攻めるぜ！
entries.en:
Don't worry about my HP.
I'm attackin'!

entries.jp: 敵の力が上昇！警戒するぜ
entries.en:
The foe's power is up!
Stay sharp!

entries.jp: オレの属性は土だ！変えてくれ
entries.en:
My element is Earth!
Change it, will ya!

entries.jp: 空間がヤバイ！オレには不利だ
entries.en:
The field's bad news!
It's against me!

entries.jp: 上昇した白虎の力、見とけよ！
entries.en:
Watch the risen power
of Byakko!

entries.jp: 上昇したオレの力、見とけよ！
entries.en: Watch my risen power!

entries.jp: よっしゃ！土の力がみなぎるぜ
entries.en:
All right! The power of
Earth is surgin' through me!

entries.jp: 攻めるしかねぇ。援護たのむぜ
entries.en:
All we can do is attack.
Back me up!

entries.jp: ヘトヘトだが、勝機はあるぜ！
entries.en:
I'm beat, but we've still
got a shot at winnin'!

entries.jp: 背水の陣だな。攻めるしかねぇ
entries.en:
Our backs are to the wall.
All we can do is attack!

entries.jp: オレしか残ってねえか。いくぞ
entries.en:
Am I the only one left?
Here goes!

entries.jp: 今だ！控えと入れ替えてくれ！
entries.en:
Now! Swap me with
my reserve!

entries.jp: 入れ替えで少し休んでいいか？
entries.en:
Can I swap out and
rest a bit?

entries.jp: 入れ替えで、体力回復したいぜ
entries.en:
I wanna swap out
and recover my HP.

entries.jp: チャンスだ！突っ込むぜ！！
entries.en:
A chance!
I'm chargin' in!!

entries.jp: チャンスだ！連携攻撃いくか？
entries.en:
A chance! Wanna try
a combo attack?

entries.jp: チャンスだ！指示たのむぜ！
entries.en:
A chance!
Give me your orders!

entries.jp: チャンスだ！技は出せるか？
entries.en:
A chance! Can ya
use a move?

entries.jp: １分経過！本気でいくぜ！
entries.en:
One minute's gone!
No more holdin' back!

entries.jp: １分経過！土の空間にしてくれ
entries.en:
One minute's gone!
Make the field Earth!

entries.jp: １分経過！連携攻撃狙おうぜ
entries.en:
One minute's gone!
Let's go for a combo attack!

entries.jp: １分経過！技で敵を黙らせてぇ
entries.en:
One minute's gone! I wanna
shut the foe up with a move!

entries.jp: 連携攻撃で一挙に敵体力を奪え
entries.en:
Drain the foe's HP all at
once with a combo attack!

entries.jp: オレの武器は投げて攻撃するぜ
entries.en:
My weapon attacks
by throwin' it!

entries.jp: オレの技は敵を何度も切り刻む
entries.en:
My move slices the foe
over and over!

entries.jp: オレは土属性で攻撃力上昇だぜ
entries.en:
Earth element raises
my Attack!

entries.jp: 相殺で行動を封じられた！
entries.en:
The clash has sealed
my action!

entries.jp: 相殺で相手の行動を封じたぜ！
entries.en:
The clash has sealed
the foe's action!

entries.jp: オレの出番だ！任せとけっ！
entries.en:
My turn!
Leave it to me!

entries.jp: オレの出番だ！暴れるぞっ！
entries.en:
My turn!
Time to cut loose!

entries.jp: オレの出番だ！白虎パワー全開
entries.en:
My turn!
Byakko power, full blast!

entries.jp: よっしゃ！オレの出番だぜ！！
entries.en:
All right!
It's my turn!!

entries.jp: 召喚されたからにゃ暴れるぜ！
entries.en:
Now that I'm summoned,
I'm cuttin' loose!

entries.jp: オレを呼ぶとは良い目してるぜ
entries.en:
Callin' me shows
ya got a good eye.

entries.jp: よっしゃ！いっちょ暴れるか！
entries.en:
All right!
Time to cut loose!

entries.jp: オレが来たからには勝つぞ！
entries.en:
Now that the great me's here,
we win!

entries.jp: オレらの連携は最強だぜ！！
entries.en:
Our combo attack
is the strongest!!

entries.jp: オレらの連携に驚いたか！！
entries.en:
Surprised by our
combo attack?!

entries.jp: オレらの連携、超強力だぜ！
entries.en:
Our combo attack
is super strong!

entries.jp: オレらの連携、決まったろ！？
entries.en:
Our combo attack
nailed it, right?!

entries.jp: この技見ても、まだ戦う気か！
entries.en:
Ya still wanna fight
after seein' this move?!

entries.jp: テメェにゃこの技もったいねェ
entries.en:
This move's wasted
on the likes of you.

entries.jp: 今のがオレの技だ。覚えとけ！
entries.en:
That was my move.
Remember it!

entries.jp: オレの技、切れ味どうだい！？
entries.en:
How's the edge on
my move, huh?!
